你在学校买纪念册了吗？
The yearbook has smiling kids on every page!
纪念册的每一页都有笑着的同学！
youngster: The little youngster plays ball in the park.
那个小家伙在公园里玩球。
Is that youngster your little brother?
那个小家伙是你的弟弟吗？
yuck: Yuck! I do not like this vegetable.
Why do you say yuck at lunch?
你吃午饭时为什么喊难吃呀？
A bug is in my food, yuck!
虫子跑到我饭菜里啦，恶心死了！
zombie: He puts on a zombie mask.
他戴上了一个僵尸面具。
Can you walk like a zombie?
你能像僵尸一样走路吗？
The zombie in the story walks like a robot!
故事里的僵尸走起路来像机器人一样僵硬！
